messages:
mike: deploy-bot just flagged eu-west canary p95 up +30% and one Dedicated customer reported timeouts. deploy-bot suggested auto-revert. thoughts? :eyes:

deploy-bot: ALERT: canary eu-west p95 latency > threshold (30m window). Suggested action: auto-revert to v3.4.1 or manual rollback. See runbook: https://runbook.internal/rollback-guides
sara: I don't love an immediate global auto-revert — this might be transient from a noisy nodepool. Can we scope to region and do a staged drain first?
kevin: agree with sara. we should check whether KV cache warming is failing on long tails. olivia, can you paste the canary histogram?
olivia: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/canary-latency?orgId=1 live panel — p95 spike aligns with 10:02-10:20 and only in eu-west. p99 is worse for requests with seq_len>1024.
ops-tilly: If it's region-limited we can do a staged drain + traffic-slice fallback to fallback-model instead of full revert. That buys time for debugging and avoids churn.
amrita: staged drain / fallback is fine but we need to notify the Dedicated customer list if we touch their pool. Also need to get SRE lead + release-owner ack for manual intervention.
mike: approve staged drain plan if SRE lead ok. kevin, what's the quick command to pin traffic off new rollout in eu-west?
kevin: run `releases traffic-split --region eu-west --remove-version v3.5.0 --to v3.4.1 --percent 100 --reason "canary p95 spike"` or do a gentle `--percent 50` first. for staging drains we also use `nodes drain --pool eu-west-canary --grace 30s`
sara: I would do 50% -> monitor 10m -> 100% if stable. also add `--no-notify` false so customers get a short note.
deploy-bot: NOTE: auto-revert will execute in 5 minutes if no manual override. To cancel: `deploybot cancel auto-revert 6432104321` or run manual rollback commands above.
amrita: I'm drafting the quick release note for Dedicated customers: "We're reverting the recent eu-west canary rollout (v3.5.0) in order to investigate increased p95 latency. No data loss expected. We'll follow up with post-mortem." anyone want edits?
olivia: Add ETA for next update: +30m. and mention fallback to v3.4.1 explicitly.
mike: ok let's do staged 50% traffic-slice now, monitor 10m, then full if metrics look good. amrita send the customer note now. kevin — execute traffic-split and drain commands. i'll stand by to approve full revert if needed. :thumbsup:
kevin: running commands now: `releases traffic-split --region eu-west --remove-version v3.5.0 --to v3.4.1 --percent 50 --reason "canary p95 spike"`
kevin: `nodes drain --pool eu-west-canary --grace 30s`
amrita: customer note sent to Dedicated alerting list and CLM.cc: "Rolling back eu-west canary to v3.4.1 (50%). We'll update in 30m."
mike: thanks. cancelling auto-revert: `deploybot cancel auto-revert 6432104321` — can someone confirm the cancel?
deploy-bot: Auto-revert cancelled by operator (kevin).
ops-tilly: monitoring dashboards. will post p95 after 10m. if p95 stays < +10% we leave as staged, otherwise escalate to full revert.
olivia: 10m snapshot: p95 back to +8% on the staged slice, overall eu-west aggregated p95 +15% but trending down.
sara: looks acceptable. keep staged and re-evaluate at +30m. mike, you still good to avoid a global revert?
mike: yep hold for 30m. if it regresses we do full 100% revert and publish a short follow-up note and PM customers. thanks team
